title: fishsuite: a Python pipeline for RNA-FISH and immunofluorescence quantification and colocalization

creators.name: Amburn, Brian
creators.affiliation: Department of Biochemistry & Molecular Biology, University of Texas Medical Branch, Galveston, TX, USA

description:
fishsuite quantifies single-molecule RNA-FISH and immunofluorescence confocal images: nuclei segmentation (StarDist, Cellpose, or Otsu), spot detection (Big-FISH Laplacian-of-Gaussian or plain LoG), subcellular compartment assignment, and colocalization between two channels.

Colocalization is reported both as threshold-free pixel statistics (Pearson, Spearman, Manders, Li's ICQ, Manders overlap, Jaccard, Dice) and as object-based measures (nearest-neighbour spot pairing, partner intensity sampled at detected spots), together with spatial null models — random-position, rotation, and translation nulls — that test whether apparent colocalization exceeds what co-distribution within the same subcellular compartment would produce by chance. The rotation null is intended for a diffuse partner channel, such as a nucleoplasm-filling RNA-binding protein, where no thresholdable object exists to mask.

Source code and documentation: https://github.com/SpaceSorcerer/fishsuite
